question.text: Starting with Rs. 1 lakh, TWRR per annum of 22.10% over 2 years (example in PM workbook). The cumulative TWRR is:

explanation.text: The Logic: TWRR cumulative (1 + annual)^2 - 1 = (1.2210)^2 - 1 = 49.09% (approx). The Trap: Simple doubling ignores compounding. Cross-Exam Context: From workbook TWRR example. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Show both annualised and cumulative TWRR in client reports.
